answer: What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. Every claim climbs the yarrow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jetty re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
